### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots or Error Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or copy the relevant log output from the Logs tab (tokens/secrets are automatically redacted).

### Environment Details
- **NS Cloud Drive Version:** (e.g. 1.0.0 Release Candidate)
- **Windows Version:** (e.g. Windows 11 23H2 / Windows 10 22H2 64-bit)
- **WinFsp Version:** (e.g. 2.0 / latest)
- **Cloud Provider:** [ ] Google Drive  [ ] TeraBox
- **Mount Mode:** [ ] Local Disk (Default)  [ ] Network Drive

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., number of mounted drives, approximate cache size, antivirus software).
